name: Hannah Okafor
summary: Registered adult nurse (NMC PIN 20A0000E) with six years' experience in adult intensive care, including three and a half years as a Band 6 Senior Staff Nurse on a 24-bed mixed ICU/HDU. Cares for level 2 and 3 patients (ventilated, proned and haemofiltered) and regularly coordinates the unit. Holds the post-registration Critical Care Nursing qualification and ALS, and is an NMC practice assessor. British citizen with full right to work in the UK, looking for a Band 6 critical care role in Greater Manchester.

experience.role: Senior Staff Nurse (Band 6), Adult Critical Care Unit
experience.company: Irwell Valley Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
experience.description: Shift coordinator on a 24-bed mixed ICU/HDU; care of level 3 patients (ventilation, tracheostomy weaning, lines, vasoactive infusions); CRRT link nurse; transfers of ventilated patients; practice assessor for students and Band 5 preceptees; led a pressure ulcer prevention audit.

experience.role: Staff Nurse (Band 5), General Intensive Care Unit
experience.description: Critical care preceptorship and competency framework steps 1-2; level 2 and 3 care through the COVID-19 surges including proning, high-flow and NIV/CPAP; IV medicines, blood products and TPN; NEWS2 and sepsis escalation; infection prevention group member.
